summary: Vitalik 称 Interfold 正是他近十年来呼吁基于 MACI 思路去构建的东西，作者 auryn_macmillan 解释其起因是 MACI 依赖诚实协调者。Aztec 强调网络上每个账户都是智能合约。nerolation 提交两项定价提案：把 EIP-8131 改写为统一交易内容下限，并新增 Block Access List 字节下限。ACDC #179 讨论 Glamsterdam devnet 与 CL EIP 取舍。

items.title: aztecnetwork：Aztec 上每个账户都是智能合约，没有 EOA，也没有外挂的抽象层；认证在用户设备上完成，排序器只验证固定大小的证明，所以多签与单签成本相同
items.title_en: aztecnetwork: every account on Aztec is a smart contract, with no EOAs and no bolt-on abstraction layers; authentication runs on the device and the sequencer only verifies a fixed size proof, so a multisig costs the same as a single signature

summary_en: Vitalik said the Interfold is what he has urged people to build with MACI ideas for almost a decade, and its author auryn_macmillan explained it grew out of MACI's reliance on an honest coordinator. Aztec stressed that every account on its network is a smart contract. nerolation submitted two pricing proposals: rewriting EIP-8131 as a Unified Transaction Content Floor and a new Block Access List Byte Floor. ACDC #179 covered Glamsterdam devnets and choices among CL EIPs.
